name: Promote a Chat Member
description: Use this method to promote or demote a user in a supergroup or a channel. [See the docs](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#promotechatmember) for more information

configurable_props.name: chatId
configurable_props.label: Chat ID
configurable_props.description: Enter the unique identifier for the target chat (e.g. `1035597319`) or username of the target public chat (in the format `@channelusername` or `@supergroupusername`). For example, if the group's public link is `t.me/mygroup`, the username is `@mygroup`.

configurable_props.name: userId
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: Enter the unique identifier of the target user.

configurable_props.name: can_change_info
configurable_props.label: Set if the Administrator Can Change Info
configurable_props.description: Pass True, if the administrator can change chat title, photo and other settings.

configurable_props.name: can_post_messages
configurable_props.label: Set if the Administrator Can Create Channel Posts
configurable_props.description: Pass True, if the administrator can create channel posts [channels only].

configurable_props.name: can_edit_messages
configurable_props.label: Set if the Administrator Can Edit Messages
configurable_props.description: Pass True, if the administrator can edit messages of other users and can pin messages [channels only].

configurable_props.name: can_delete_messages
configurable_props.label: Set if the Administrator Can Delete Messages
configurable_props.description: Pass True, if the administrator can delete messages of other users [channels only].

configurable_props.name: can_invite_users
configurable_props.label: Set if the Administrator Can Invite Users
configurable_props.description: Pass True, if the administrator can invite new users to the chat.

configurable_props.name: can_restrict_members
configurable_props.label: Set if the Administrator Can Restrict Members
configurable_props.description: Pass True, if the administrator can restrict, ban or unban chat members.

configurable_props.name: can_pin_messages
configurable_props.label: Set if the Administrator Can Pin Messages
configurable_props.description: Pass True, if the administrator can pin messages [supergroups only].

configurable_props.name: can_promote_members
configurable_props.label: Set if the Administrator Can Promote Members
configurable_props.description: Pass True, if the administrator can add new administrators with a subset of their own privileges or demote administrators that they have promoted, directly or indirectly (promoted by administrators that were appointed by them).
